```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(psych)
library(R2jags)
library(coda)
library(patchwork)

main_path <- getwd()
data_path <- file.path(main_path, "data/cleaned_data")
study_1_path <- file.path(main_path, "study_1")
results_path <- file.path(main_path, "results")
models_path <- file.path(main_path, "models")
figure_path <- file.path(study_1_path, "figures")

set.seed(7386)

ges_summary <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "ges_summary.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
ges_long_clean <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "ges_long_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)
sound_events <- read_csv(file.path(data_path, "sound_events.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

source(file.path(main_path, "overall_functions.R"))
```

```{r}
# Restrict to the Study 1 analytic sample
ges_study <- ges_summary %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "COOP")
```

```{r}
# GES availability and participant-level descriptives

ges_availability <- ges_study %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    participant.code,
    gender,
    ges_score
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(
    ges_available = !is.na(ges_score)
  )

# GES availability: overall
ges_availability %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_ges_available = sum(ges_available),
    prop_ges_available = mean(ges_available),
    percent_ges_available =
      100 * mean(ges_available)
  )

# GES availability: by gender
ges_availability %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_ges_available = sum(ges_available),
    prop_ges_available = mean(ges_available),
    percent_ges_available =
      100 * mean(ges_available),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Participants with valid GES scores
ges_descriptive_sample <- ges_availability %>%
  filter(ges_available)

# GES descriptives: overall
ges_descriptive_sample %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    ges_mean = mean(ges_score),
    ges_sd = sd(ges_score)
  )

# GES descriptives: by gender
ges_descriptive_sample %>%
  group_by(gender) %>%
  summarise(
    n_participants = n(),
    ges_mean = mean(ges_score),
    ges_sd = sd(ges_score),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r}
# Distribution plots
ges_descriptive_sample  %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = gender, y = ges_score, fill = gender)) +
  geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.3) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.08, alpha = 0.4) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", size = 2) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(
    title = "Study 1 GES by gender",
    x = NULL,
    y = "GES (mean item score)"
  )
```
## Paired gender comparison
```{r}
ges_paired <- ges_descriptive_sample %>%
  filter(gender %in% c("Female", "Male")) %>%
  dplyr::select(id, gender, ges_score) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = gender, values_from = ges_score) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Female), !is.na(Male)) %>%
  mutate(ges_difference_female_male = Female - Male)

ges_paired %>%
  summarise(
    n_complete_dyads = n(),
    mean_female = mean(Female),
    sd_female = sd(Female),
    mean_male = mean(Male),
    sd_male = sd(Male),
    mean_difference =
      mean(ges_difference_female_male),
    sd_difference =
      sd(ges_difference_female_male))
```

### Assumption assessment for paired t-test

```{r}
# Boxplot of within-dyad difference scores
p_ges_difference_boxplot <- ggplot(
  ges_paired, aes(x = "", y = ges_difference_female_male)) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linetype = 2,
    linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.35,
    outlier.shape = NA) +
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.08,
    height = 0,
    alpha = 0.70,
    size = 1.8) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Female − male GES difference") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_ges_difference_boxplot

# Q-Q plot of within-dyad difference scores
p_ges_difference_qq <- ggplot(
  ges_paired, aes(sample = ges_difference_female_male)) +
  stat_qq(
    alpha = 0.75,
    size = 1.8) +
  stat_qq_line(
    linewidth = 0.7) +
  labs(
    x = "Theoretical quantiles",
    y = "Observed quantiles") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

p_ges_difference_qq

# Shapiro-Wilk test of within-dyad difference scores
shapiro.test(ges_paired$ges_difference_female_male)
```

### Paired-samples t-test
```{r}
t.test(
  ges_paired$Female,
  ges_paired$Male,
  paired = TRUE)
```

## Calculate Cronbach's alpha

```{r}
ges_items_long <- ges_long_clean %>%
  filter(!excluded, setup == "COOP") %>%
  semi_join(
    ges_study %>%
      dplyr::select(id, participant.code) %>%
      distinct(),
    by = c("id", "participant.code"))

ges_items_long %>% count(variable)

ges_items_long %>%
  group_by(id, participant.code) %>%
  summarise(
    n_items = n_distinct(variable),
    n_answered = sum(!is.na(value)),
    .groups = "drop") %>%
  count(n_items, n_answered)

ges_items_wide <- ges_items_long %>%
  dplyr::select(id, participant.code, variable, value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = value) %>%
  arrange(id, participant.code)

ges_item_data <- ges_items_wide %>%
  dplyr::select(starts_with("q")) %>%
  dplyr::select(order(parse_number(names(.))))

ges_alpha <- psych::alpha(
  ges_item_data,
  check.keys = FALSE,
  warnings = FALSE)

ges_alpha
```

## GES and button-press behaviour
```{r}
# One valid GES score per participant
ges_buttonpress_people <- ges_study %>%
  filter(
    gender %in% c("Female", "Male"),
    !is.na(ges_score)) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    id,
    participant.code,
    gender,
    ges_score) %>%
  distinct()

# Keep only dyads with valid GES scores for both participants
complete_ges_dyads <- ges_buttonpress_people %>%
  count(id) %>%
  filter(n == 2) %>%
  pull(id)

ges_buttonpress_people <- ges_buttonpress_people %>%
  filter(id %in% complete_ges_dyads) %>%
  mutate(
    ges_z = as.numeric(scale(ges_score)))

# Put female and male scores on the same dyad row
ges_dyad_scores <- ges_buttonpress_people %>%
  dplyr::select(id, gender, ges_z) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = gender,
    values_from = ges_z) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(Female),
    !is.na(Male)) %>%
  arrange(id) %>%
  mutate(
    dyad_ID = row_number())

print(ges_dyad_scores, n = 50)
```

```{r}
ges_dyad_scores %>%
  mutate(
    ges_difference_female_male =
      Female - Male) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dyads = n(),
    mean_difference =
      mean(ges_difference_female_male),
    sd_difference =
      sd(ges_difference_female_male),
    min_difference =
      min(ges_difference_female_male),
    max_difference =
      max(ges_difference_female_male))
```

```{r}
ges_buttonpress_events <- sound_events %>%
  filter(setup == "COOP") %>%
  inner_join(
    ges_dyad_scores %>%
      dplyr::select(id, dyad_ID),
    by = "id") %>%
  arrange(id, sound_event_order) %>%
  mutate(
    response = case_when(
      responder_gender == "none"   ~ 1L,
      responder_gender == "Male"   ~ 2L,
      responder_gender == "Female" ~ 3L,
      TRUE ~ NA_integer_)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(response))

# Number of included dyads
n_distinct(ges_buttonpress_events$id)

# Number of events per dyad
ges_buttonpress_events %>%
  count(id) %>%
  count(n)

# Overall response counts
ges_buttonpress_events %>%
  count(responder_gender)

# Response counts within dyads
print((ges_buttonpress_events %>%
  count(id, responder_gender) %>%
  arrange(id, responder_gender)), n = 80)
```

### JAGS
```{r}
data_list_ges_buttonpress <- list(
  N = nrow(ges_buttonpress_events),
  D = nrow(ges_dyad_scores),

  y = as.integer(
    ges_buttonpress_events$response),

  dyad = as.integer(
    ges_buttonpress_events$dyad_ID),

  x_male = as.numeric(
    ges_dyad_scores$Male),

  x_female = as.numeric(
    ges_dyad_scores$Female))

params_ges_buttonpress <- c(
  "alpha_male",
  "alpha_female",
  "beta_own",
  "beta_partner",
  "beta_relative",
  "sigma_press",
  "sigma_gender",
  "beta_own_prior",
  "beta_partner_prior",
  "beta_relative_prior")
```

```{r}
ges_buttonpress_samples_path <- file.path(
  results_path,
  "s1_jags_ges_buttonpress.rds")

if (file.exists(ges_buttonpress_samples_path)) {

  samples_ges_buttonpress <-
    readRDS(ges_buttonpress_samples_path)

} else {

  samples_ges_buttonpress <- jags.parallel(
    data = data_list_ges_buttonpress,
    inits = NULL,
    parameters.to.save =
      params_ges_buttonpress,
    model.file = file.path(
      models_path,
      "s1_buttonpress_GES_hearing.bugs"),
    n.chains = 12,
    n.iter = 25000,
    n.burnin = 5000,
    n.thin = 1)

  saveRDS(
    samples_ges_buttonpress,
    ges_buttonpress_samples_path)}

samples_ges_buttonpress
```

```{r}
ges_buttonpress_summary <-
  samples_ges_buttonpress$BUGSoutput$summary[
    c(
      "beta_own",
      "beta_partner",
      "beta_relative",
      "sigma_press",
      "sigma_gender"),]

ges_buttonpress_summary
```

```{r}
# Posterior probabilities and evidence ratios
mcmc_ges <- as.mcmc(samples_ges_buttonpress)
ges_buttonpress_draws <- as.matrix(mcmc_ges)

pp_ges_own <-
  mean(ges_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_own"] < 0)

pp_ges_partner <-
  mean(ges_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_partner"] < 0)

pp_ges_relative <-
  mean(ges_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_relative"] < 0)

er_ges_own <-
  pp_ges_own / (1 - pp_ges_own)

er_ges_partner <-
  pp_ges_partner / (1 - pp_ges_partner)

er_ges_relative <-
  pp_ges_relative / (1 - pp_ges_relative)

tibble(
  effect = c("own", "partner", "relative"),
  posterior_probability_negative = c(
    pp_ges_own,
    pp_ges_partner,
    pp_ges_relative),
  evidence_ratio_negative_vs_positive = c(
    er_ges_own,
    er_ges_partner,
    er_ges_relative))

# Bayes factors for point-null effects at zero

# Own GES effect
d_post_ges_own <-
  density(ges_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_own"])

d_prior_ges_own <-
  density(ges_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_own_prior"])

post_at_0_ges_own <- approx(
  d_post_ges_own$x,
  d_post_ges_own$y,
  xout = 0)$y

prior_at_0_ges_own <- approx(
  d_prior_ges_own$x,
  d_prior_ges_own$y,
  xout = 0)$y

bf01_ges_own <-
  post_at_0_ges_own /
  prior_at_0_ges_own


# Partner GES effect
d_post_ges_partner <-
  density(ges_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_partner"])

d_prior_ges_partner <-
  density(ges_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_partner_prior"])

post_at_0_ges_partner <- approx(
  d_post_ges_partner$x,
  d_post_ges_partner$y,
  xout = 0)$y

prior_at_0_ges_partner <- approx(
  d_prior_ges_partner$x,
  d_prior_ges_partner$y,
  xout = 0)$y

bf01_ges_partner <-
  post_at_0_ges_partner /
  prior_at_0_ges_partner


# Relative within-dyad GES effect
d_post_ges_relative <-
  density(ges_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_relative"])

d_prior_ges_relative <-
  density(ges_buttonpress_draws[, "beta_relative_prior"])

post_at_0_ges_relative <- approx(
  d_post_ges_relative$x,
  d_post_ges_relative$y,
  xout = 0)$y

prior_at_0_ges_relative <- approx(
  d_prior_ges_relative$x,
  d_prior_ges_relative$y,
  xout = 0)$y

bf01_ges_relative <-
  post_at_0_ges_relative /
  prior_at_0_ges_relative


c(own = bf01_ges_own,
  partner = bf01_ges_partner,
  relative = bf01_ges_relative)
```

# Model diagnostics
```{r}
# Traceplots
plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s1_ges_buttonpress_traceplots.png")

if (!file.exists(plot_png_path)) {

  mcmc_list_ges <- as.mcmc(samples_ges_buttonpress)

  trace_df_ges <- purrr::map2_dfr(
    mcmc_list_ges,
    seq_along(mcmc_list_ges),
    ~ as.data.frame(.x) %>%
      rownames_to_column("iteration") %>%
      mutate(
        iteration = as.integer(iteration),
        chain = paste0("chain_", .y))) %>%
    dplyr::select(
      iteration,
      chain,
      alpha_male,
      alpha_female,
      beta_own,
      beta_partner,
      beta_relative,
      sigma_press,
      sigma_gender) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = -c(iteration, chain),
      names_to = "parameter",
      values_to = "value")

  p_trace_ges <- ggplot(
    trace_df_ges,
    aes(
      x = iteration,
      y = value,
      colour = chain)) +
    geom_line(
      alpha = 0.6,
      linewidth = 0.25) +
    facet_wrap(
      ~ parameter,
      scales = "free_y",
      ncol = 2) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(
      title = "Traceplots: GES and button-press model",
      x = "Iteration",
      y = "Value",
      colour = "Chain")

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
    plot_object = p_trace_ges,
    width = 9,
    height = 10,
    dpi = 300)

} else {

  show_or_save_ggplot(
    plot_png_path = plot_png_path)}
```

```{r}
ges_buttonpress_draws <-
  as.matrix(as.mcmc(samples_ges_buttonpress))

plot_ges_own <- plot_prior_posterior(
  draws = ges_buttonpress_draws,
  posterior_name = "beta_own",
  prior_name = "beta_own_prior",
  xlab = "Own GES effect",
  vline = 0,
  central_prob = 0.99)

plot_ges_partner <- plot_prior_posterior(
  draws = ges_buttonpress_draws,
  posterior_name = "beta_partner",
  prior_name = "beta_partner_prior",
  xlab = "Partner GES effect",
  vline = 0,
  central_prob = 0.99)

plot_ges_relative <- plot_prior_posterior(
  draws = ges_buttonpress_draws,
  posterior_name = "beta_relative",
  prior_name = "beta_relative_prior",
  xlab = "Relative within-dyad GES effect",
  vline = 0,
  central_prob = 0.99)

p_ges_prior_post <-
  plot_ges_own /
  plot_ges_partner /
  plot_ges_relative

plot_png_path <- file.path(
  figure_path,
  "s1_ges_buttonpress_prior_posterior.png")

show_or_save_ggplot(
  plot_png_path = plot_png_path,
  plot_object = p_ges_prior_post,
  width = 9,
  height = 8,
  dpi = 300
)
```
